title.en: Genres are labels, not purity tests
title.zh: 流派是标签，不是纯度测验

summary.en: Stop asking "is this really metal?" Ask which records and scenes it sits next to.
summary.zh: 别问「这算不算正统金属」。问它和哪些唱片、哪些场景坐一桌。

body.en:
Genre tags exist because listeners need drawers. The drawers help. Purity tests do not.

Rough map: blues and rock & roll supply the basic riff vocabulary. Psychedelic stretches form and studio tricks. Prog keeps long structures and odd meters. Hard rock turns amps up and keeps songs relatively direct. Metal tightens rules, speed, and tone. Punk cuts length and technique; post-punk puts atmosphere and art-school methods back in. Grunge mixes punk dynamics with heavy riffs. Britpop puts UK guitar bands back on the charts. Indie is a shifting umbrella for non-major, guitar-led scenes.

Bands that sit between tags—Radiohead, The Clash, Tame Impala—are normal. Scenes leak.

Use the Genre Map as orientation, not a courtroom. Branched means a sub-style left the parent. Influenced means borrowing. Fused means two families mix on the same record. If two tags conflict, play the landmark track on the band page and decide with your ears.
body.zh:
流派标签存在，是因为听众需要抽屉。抽屉有用。纯度测验没用。

粗分：Blues 和 rock & roll 提供基础 riff 语汇。迷幻拉长曲式和录音室手法。Prog 保留长结构和怪拍。Hard rock 把音箱拧大、歌仍相对直接。Metal 收紧规则、速度和音色。Punk 砍长度和技术；后朋克把氛围和艺术学院手法加回来。Grunge 用朋克动态配重型 riff。Britpop 把英国吉他乐队送回榜单。Indie 是非主流吉他场景的滑动伞称。

卡在标签之间的乐队——Radiohead、The Clash、Tame Impala——很正常。场景会渗漏。

Genre Map 用来定向，不当法庭。「裂变」是子风格离开母体；「影响」是借用；「融合」是同一张盘上两家人混在一起。两个标签打架时，去乐队页听 landmark，用耳朵定。
